data.text:
finding-records

How to Find components, atoms, and skills

Use search to find project records and read their type and source.

Enter a question such as "where are components?" or "how do I run the site?". Read the best answer and open other results when needed.
Each result shows its exact registered type above an icon. The name, ID, and source show which record supplied it. A skill can provide usage instructions.
The root rab.project.json lists source folders. Components are registered under src/components. Dashboard-owned components can be inside src/dashboards. Read the source path on each result.
To list actual records, request "list all components" or "find all atoms". If search finds a matching tool, review and confirm it using the tool guide.
If a new file is missing from search, check its metadata and registered source folder. Run npm run index from the project root after the requested change.
